markdown_line: Do not use Markdown syntax in user-facing replies (no headings like ###, no **bold**, no backticks, no markdown links).
purpose: WEB_SUBAGENT_PLAN §16.1 (R2, 2026-09-17): the one reviewed reply-policy line of the main prompt, applied forward to the pinned-SOURCE lifecycle fixtures after the read_file description addition, the reasoning_history removal and the r6 subagent-dialogue migration (r7 chronology restores the candidate separately). Exactly the 45 captures that carry the main prompt's reply-style section (main-agent turns and messaging-style subagent runs) gain the line once, immediately after the Markdown line; the 3 summarizer captures carry no reply-style section and stay byte-identical. reply_policy_line: When the user asked you to find something concrete (a product, a place, a service, a document, an offer), give each item's link or location next to its name when available — the one bare URL or address that lets the user act on it, not a list of sources — and say when it could not be established; never guess a URL or an address. Don't add unnecessary links, and keep the message short.
